description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Own the video pipeline end to end, from technician camera capture through processing to customer-ready clips and inspection reports. You will build dependable systems for real-world service environments, where connectivity and video quality can be unpredictable.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build resilient video ingestion that supports unreliable Wi-Fi, resumable uploads, and device interruptions.

 - Scale video processing from capture through delivery of finished clips.

 - Integrate vision and language models to identify technician findings and draft inspection summaries from footage.

 - Own backend processing, job state management, and monitoring, tracking turnaround time, failure rates, and output quality.

 - Keep findings traceable to source footage and straightforward to correct before customer delivery.

 - Observe service-floor workflows and use what you learn to improve the product.

 - Help recruit and mentor engineers joining the team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on experience building and operating production systems, with clear examples of users, tradeoffs, failures, and how fixes were validated.

 - Strong backend engineering skills; experience scaling video systems is a plus.

 - ML or computer vision experience is welcome when paired with backend systems deployed in production.

 - Pragmatism, sound product judgment, and comfort working with ambiguous real-world data and customer feedback.

 - Early-stage team experience or a side project with real users is valued. Languages and frameworks are flexible, and automotive experience is not required.

 - New graduates with strong side projects are welcome.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $225,000 to $330,000 annually, plus stock options. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco.
